'''Football Club Ballkani''' ({{langx|sq|Klubi Futbollistik Ballkani}}), commonly known as '''Ballkani''', is a professional [[Football team|football club]] based in [[Suva Reka|Suhareka]], [[Kosovo]]. The club plays in the [[Football Superleague of Kosovo|Kosovo Superleague]], which is the top tier of football in the country.

On 25 August 2022, after a victory over [[KF Shkupi|Shkupi]] of North Macedonia, Ballkani made history by qualifying for the group stages of the [[2022–23 UEFA Europa Conference League|Europa Conference League]]; becoming the first ever side from Kosovo to reach the group stages of a UEFA club competition. The following year, they managed to repeat the same achievement and qualified for the [[2023–24 UEFA Europa Conference League|2023–24 edition]]."}}
